scope: OMP native-plugin route readiness for Personal cutover. All mutations used temporary directories; no model request, authentication, real OMP home, marketplace, or Personal checkout was changed.

native_cli.isolated_state: HOME and PI_CONFIG_DIR were temporary paths
native_cli.result: All three exited 0. The list reported demo@audit at a temporary cache path; no real ~/.omp profile was created. This proves marketplace registration, ordinary-plugin install, and native registry readback only.

plgnz_isolated_probe.command: OPEN_PLUGIN_HOME=<temporary> OPEN_PLUGIN_OMP_ROOT=<temporary> bun run src/cli.ts add <temporary ordinary collection> --target omp --json; list; doctor
plgnz_isolated_probe.result: add, list, and doctor exited 0. doctor returned a current-content check for demo@audit. bun test test/omp-lifecycle.test.ts also passed: 6 pass, 0 fail.

loader_boundary.manual_policy: The generic native skill layer maps disableModelInvocation to hidden and exposes explicit /skill:<name> use, but this is not the Agent Plugins marketplace route.
loader_boundary.marketplace_policy: Personal's marketplace route uses the closed Agent Skills field set. Its observed behavior skips a skill with disable-model-invocation instead of preserving its manual-only semantics.
loader_boundary.commands: Historical snapshot: native commands directory discovery was source-evidenced, but marketplace-installed command behavior had not yet been probed. Superseded for that question by docs/evidence/omp-command-discovery-20260923.json: an isolated OMP 18.1.4 marketplace install yielded no discovered command because marketplace roots are excluded before the OMP command provider.

semantic_blockers.addy: contains commands/ and .claude/commands; OMP marketplace command discovery is now proven unsupported (see omp-command-discovery-20260923.json)
semantic_blockers.try-skill: contains a manual-only skill carrying disable-model-invocation

personal_selection.note: A strict projection can make the manual-policy packages pass the writer's structural check only by removing the policy. That is not native semantic support and is not a valid cutover.

adoption.existing_real_store: The current OMP registry lists all seven Personal packages as user installs, with no .plgnz-install.json ownership markers.
adoption.adapter_gap: ompWriter neither advertises supportsAdoption nor implements opts.adoptExisting. Its prior-user-row and cache checks reject every legacy Personal install.

decision: The OMP adapter is ready for isolated ordinary-plugin lifecycle only. Native-only consolidation is blocked until legacy-install adoption is implemented and the manual-policy and Addy-command semantics have native marketplace evidence. Keep the existing OMP route for those blocked packages; do not project manual skills as ordinary skills.
